name: Kanchenjunga Cascade Homestay
description: Nestled in the serene pine forests of Lamahatta, this homestay offers breathtaking, unobstructed views of Mt. Kanchenjunga. Enjoy organic home-cooked meals, evening bonfires, and a peaceful retreat away from city noise. Perfect for nature lovers and couples.

name: Sitong Orange Blossom Stay
description: Located in the heart of the Orange Village, this beautiful eco-stay allows you to wake up to the sweet scent of citrus and panoramic valley views. During winter, the trees are loaded with oranges. We arrange local bird-watching tours and village walks.

name: Takdah Heritage Eco Lodge
description: Experience colonial charm in our British-era heritage bungalow in Takdah. Surrounded by lush tea gardens and dense cedar forests, this lodge offers antique wooden interiors, a vintage fireplace, and the finest Darjeeling tea brewed fresh from the estate.

name: Darjeeling Mist Haven
description: A cozy, budget-friendly stay just 15 minutes walking distance from the Mall Road. Enjoy the glittering lights of Darjeeling town at night and the majestic snow-capped peaks in the morning. Fast Wi-Fi available for workation travelers.

name: Mirik Lake View Cottage
description: Wake up to the tranquil waters of Sumendu Lake. Our wooden cottages offer a private balcony, modern amenities, and a direct walking path down to the lake. We offer boating arrangements and horse riding on request.
